2607.00832.title: Pano2World: End-to-End 3D Generation via Unified Multi-View Sequences
2607.00832.paper_summary: A single panorama captures the full visual sphere from one camera center, yet confines users to looking around in place without enabling true scene exploration. Converting a single panorama into a persistent, renderable 3D representation for free-viewpoint navigation has attracted growing interest; existing methods either adopt iterative per-view completion that propagates inpainting results to update the underlying geometry, leading to progressive error accumulation and cumbersome multi-step pipelines, or leverage the temporal consistency priors of video generation models, yet the continuous-trajectory constraint intrinsic to such models limits their flexibility in covering scenes from multiple directions simultaneously. We present Pano2World, which takes a single indoor panorama as input and directly outputs a persistent, explorable 3D Gaussian scene. Given the source panorama, Pano2World first reconstructs a coarse 3D Gaussian proxy and renders it at adaptively sampled nearby poses to obtain geometrically aligned guidance panoramas; a panoramic diffusion model then jointly denoises all target views via View-Aware Attention Routing, where each target view simultaneously receives geometric constraints from its corresponding guidance panorama and global semantic guidance from the source panorama, naturally enforcing cross-view consistency. To avoid the information loss incurred by decoding the multi-view hidden features formed during joint denoising back to the pixel domain via VAE, we introduce Latent Feature Adapter, a geometry-aware bridge module that directly distills these hidden features into a scene latent, subsequently decoded into the final 3D Gaussian scene. Experiments demonstrate that Pano2World significantly outperforms existing methods on the multi-position panoramic novel-view synthesis benchmark.
2607.00832.paper_summary_zh: 一個單一的全景圖捕捉了從一個相機中心的完整視覺範圍，但卻限制使用者在原地環顧，而無法真正探索場景。將單一全景圖轉換為持久的、可渲染的3D表示以進行自由視點導航引起了越來越多的關注；現有的方法要麼採用迭代的每視圖完成，將修補結果傳播以更新基礎幾何，導致逐步的錯誤累積和繁瑣的多步驟流程，要麼利用視頻生成模型的時間一致性先驗，但這些模型固有的連續軌跡約束限制了它們在同時從多個方向覆蓋場景的靈活性。我們提出了Pano2World，它將單一的室內全景圖作為輸入，並直接輸出一個持久的、可探索的3D高斯場景。給定源全景圖，Pano2World首先重建一個粗略的3D高斯代理，並在自適應取樣的附近姿勢上渲染，以獲得幾何對齊的指導全景圖；然後，通過視圖感知注意路由，泛光擴散模型共同去噪所有目標視圖，其中每個目標視圖同時從其對應的指導全景圖接收幾何約束，並從源全景圖接收全局語義指導，自然地強制跨視圖一致性。為了避免通過VAE將在聯合去噪過程中形成的多視圖隱藏特徵解碼回像素域而造成的信息損失，我們引入了潛在特徵適配器，這是一個幾何感知的橋接模塊，直接將這些隱藏特徵提煉為場景潛在，隨後解碼為最終的3D高斯場景。實驗表明，Pano2World在多位置全景新視圖合成基準上顯著超越了現有方法。
